description: Open roles from up to 5 named company boards in one call. Pass boards as system:token pairs separated by commas, where system is greenhouse, lever or ashby, e.g. greenhouse:airbnb,lever:spotify,ashby:ashby. Each job says which board it came from. A board that does not exist is reported as not found. Title, location, team, posted time, apply link; salary is not in these feeds. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

boards.description: Comma-separated system:token pairs, max 5, e.g. greenhouse:airbnb,lever:spotify

limit.description: How many jobs in total, 1 to 100 (default 20)

name: jobs_multi_job_board
title: Jobs Multi Job Board
